title: Property Refurbishment Co-ordinator
description:
Creative Support own and manage a portfolio of supported accommodation across the country.

We require an individual with experience of inspecting properties, devising schedules of works and co-ordinating property works to work as part of our busy Property Services Team based in Stockport.

The Property Refurbishment Co-ordinator will contribute to the effective maintenance of company property assets and co-ordinate a variety of property related works including urgent repair works, reconfiguration works and refurbishment projects. The Property Refurbishment Co-ordinator will attend properties post works to sign off on quality.

The Property Refurbishment Co-ordinator will be based with and work closely with the Stockport office-based Property Services Team. They will also work with senior staff at Creative Support services across the country, building consultants, external contractors and the in-house maintenance team.

Applicants must have excellent written skills and be confident in following up post inspection via email and/or letter with findings from inspection and recommendations for next steps.

Applicants should hold a full driving license and be willing to travel.

As a car is required for this role, employees may be provided with a company car from an agreed range of models and costs. Alternatively, a monthly taxable car allowance of £250, or use of company pool cars can be offered.

Employees who use their own vehicle for work can claim business mileage at approved rates. Costs incurred on company business will be reimbursed on receipt of approved claim forms.

Any employee using a vehicle for work must ensure they have business use motor insurance. A valid certificate of insurance must be provided for inspection before and during employment.

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact the Property Services Manager, Olivia Turley, on or call

Vacancy Reference Number: 93685

Full training is provided, as is the opportunity to work towards QCF Diploma in Health and Social Care. Benefits of working with Creative Support include a probationary bonus, pension contributions, 33 days Annual Leave and company paid enhanced DBS.

title: Administrator
description:
Are you an organised Office Administrator looking for a varied office-based role where no two days are the same?

This is an opportunity for an Office Administrator to join a growing and successful construction business based in the Stockport area. As an Office Administrator, you will provide essential support to both the accounts team and the wider office, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of administrative processes. This Office Administrator role would suit someone who enjoys a varied workload, has excellent attention to detail, and takes pride in delivering high-quality administrative support.

Working as part of a friendly and supportive team, you'll play an important role in keeping the office running efficiently while supporting colleagues, customers and suppliers on a daily basis.

- Basic Microsoft Excel skills
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Previous accounts administration experience would be beneficial but is not essential
- A professional, friendly and reliable approach
- Ability to work well both independently and as part of a team

What will you get in return for your work as an Office Administrator?
- 13.00- 15.00 per hour, depending on experience
- Full-time, office-based role
- Flexible working hours between 9:00am/9:30am and 3:00pm-5:00pm
- Monday to Friday working pattern
- This role is temporary to permanent
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Varied role with a mix of office and accounts administration
- Stable opportunity with a well-established and growing construction business

title: Administrator

Desirable
- Experience within a logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or office environment.

- Competitive pay of £14.00 per hour.
- Monday to Friday working pattern.

title: Junior Data Administrator
description:
Junior Data Administrator

Location: Greater Manchester

Salary: 25,000 - 28,000

Working Pattern: Fully Office Based

We're working with a growing ecommerce and retail business that's looking for a Junior Data Administrator to join its Data & Analytics function.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their data career who wants to gain hands-on commercial experience while working directly with an experienced Head of Data.

You'll play an important role in ensuring the business has accurate and reliable data, with a particular focus on stock, orders and operational information.

The Role

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing and maintaining stock and order data
- Checking data quality and investigating discrepancies
- Producing and maintaining regular reports
- Working with Excel and internal business systems
- Ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Supporting teams across the business with data queries
- Working directly with the Head of Data on wider reporting and data projects
- Helping improve existing data processes as the business continues to grow

What We're Looking For

We're not looking for years of commercial experience. This could suit a recent graduate or someone with some initial experience in Data, Administration, Reporting, Ecommerce or a similar position.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong Excel skills
- Good attention to detail
- Confidence working with numbers and large amounts of information
- An analytical mindset and ability to spot inconsistencies
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- An interest in developing a career within Data & Analytics

Experience with ecommerce, stock or order data would be advantageous but isn't essential

What's On Offer?

Salary of 25,000 - 28,000 plus the opportunity to join a growing business where you'll work closely with the Head of Data and gain exposure to the wider Data & Analytics function.

If you're early in your career and looking for an opportunity to build genuine commercial data experience, we'd love to hear from you.

- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large volumes of data.

title: Junior Project Coordinator
description:
Junior Project Coordinator

Location: Altrincham
Salary: £25,000 - £27,000 DOE
Hours: Monday - Friday, 37.5 hours per week

Are you highly organised with excellent attention to detail and looking to build a career in project coordination?

We're recruiting on behalf of an innovative and fast-growing technology business that delivers market-leading digital solutions to some of the UK's biggest household names.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive and collaborative Project Team where you'll gain exposure to large-scale technology deployment projects, receive full training, and develop your career within project management.

The Role

Working closely with the Project Team, you'll provide essential administrative and coordination support to ensure multiple deployment projects run smoothly from planning through to completion.

No two days are the same, and you'll play a key role in keeping projects on track, maintaining accurate documentation and ensuring stakeholders are kept up to date throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to Project Managers across multiple deployment projects.
- Maintain project plans, trackers and documentation.
- Prepare project reports and update stakeholders on progress.
- Schedule meetings and coordinate project activities.
- Review project documentation and ensure records are accurate and complete.
- Monitor project milestones and deadlines.
- Escalate any risks or issues where appropriate.
- Support continuous improvement within project processes.
- Assist with general administration to ensure successful project delivery.

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive and enjoys working in a fast-paced environment.

You'll ideally have:
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A confident and professional approach when working with colleagues and stakeholders.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Outlook.
- A willingness to learn and develop within a project environment.
- The ability to remain calm under pressure and adapt to changing priorities.

Desirable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be advantageous but is not essential:
- Project Administration or Project Coordination.
- Working with project plans or deployment schedules.
- Advanced Excel skills including Pivot Tables and XLOOKUP.
- Technology, IT, retail or hospitality environments.
- Working with field engineers, suppliers or third-party contractors.
- Knowledge of project management principles.

What's in it for you?
- Salary of £25,000-£27,000 depending on experience
- Benefits package
- Full training and ongoing development
- Genuine career progression opportunities
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Opportunity to work on exciting, high-profile technology projects for nationally recognised brands
